observations.text:
LOOKING GLASS · GATE 7 · FINAL APPROVED STAGE
A working instrument.
An open human question.

The eight frozen cases and replay pass as a qualified instrument-readiness result. Human understanding and a general advantage for the geometric or attention view remain untested.

Accepted run G7-INTERPRET-002 · build g7-90e64952eb028069. Exact task explanations remain behind deliberate reveal in the instrument; this report contains no option key.

Open paused instrument
Read full packet
Independent audit

For a first attempt, use the cases before the tour or explanations. Repeated exposure changes any later interpretation trial.

8
frozen synthetic cases
36
matching checkpoint observations
214
actual browser observations
0
human participants
Watch and try
At 0s, compare Static sheet, Prescribed sequence and Choose a frame. The same finite observations and raw coordinate tables are available through different access patterns. Sequence frames last 2 seconds with no interpolation.
At 24s, inspect the supplied slice/projection sheet. At 42s, switch the same reference/receiver frame between Local objects and Plain table.
Submit an answer or skip, then intentionally choose Reveal model explanation. Submission alone gives no grading. Reopen saved start or reload clears the transient responses and explanations.
Replay from start visits all eight cases and naturally stops paused at 48s. It is a software demonstration with no participant answers.

Teaching: 60 seconds recommended; task time: 45 seconds recommended. These are proposed, unenforced limits, with pausing and revisiting available. No participant exposure or timing outcome was measured.

Five separate conclusions

The independent core audit passes the exact frozen build and closed evidence. Source-informed agents checked the model and interface; they did not take a human comprehension test.

Question	Expected	Observed	Interpretation	Unresolved
Mathematical fidelity	Independent equations and the frozen key agree across eight synthetic cases.	The independent oracle passes projection, observability, slice, reference and checkpoint checks.	The declared model and task instrument are internally consistent.	Recovery assumes supplied raw 3D coordinates, known transforms and correct point correspondence; it is not recovery from SVG pixels.
Information recovery and ambiguity	Distinguish properties determined by the supplied observations from compatible alternatives.	The audit verifies both determining observations and explicit non-uniqueness witnesses; exact task explanations remain behind deliberate reveal.	The instrument supports bounded model questions and preserves genuine insufficiency.	No arbitrary shape reconstruction, unique higher-dimensional physical cause, or general inference from appearance is established.
Actual human understanding	Report only real, separately authorized human observations.	Zero human participants. One software option submission and one null skip tested response/reveal mechanics.	Human understanding is untested; there is no human score.	Accuracy, confusion, learning, transfer and perceived usefulness require actual participation.
Views, controls and reference changes	Same finite data across three geometry presentations; the same records/rules in local objects and plain table.	All eight tasks and five conditions appeared in the browser. Geometry retains the same full observation set; the attention pair matches each of its three frames and information hashes.	The controls and reference/receiver transitions work. Equal facts do not establish equal cognitive effort or a visual advantage.	Static, serial and selectable access differ in memory and control demands. Dense records, small thumbnails and vertical scrolling remain; human clarity was not tested.
Strongest counterexample and next experiment	Retain failures and end with the smallest proposal that could change the conclusion.	Non-unique observations and missing dependencies remain explicit. The preserved Gate 4 example shows a stored 3D movie can reproduce a selected projection movie. Candidate 001 presentation/event defects are preserved and corrected in 002.	Faithful software and a convincing appearance do not by themselves establish unique origin or comprehension.	Propose one separately requested think-aloud session on unrevealed cases with a fixed first-exposure plan and plain comparison. It is unapproved and unrun.

The same observation set does not mean the same memory burden, simultaneous access or drawing size. The plain view condenses records into rows; local objects make grouping prominent. Neither has a demonstrated comprehension advantage.

The bounded answer is that the instrument exposes selected properties of declared four- and five-coordinate models and preserves inspectable, reference-dependent fictional records. Numerical recovery assumes known raw observations and transforms. It does not establish inference from arbitrary pixels, a unique physical origin, human understanding or social meaning.

Inspected originals: failure, correction and comparison

These four images are unmodified viewport captures, with task/condition and capture limits recorded. The first candidate’s failure is retained.

Preserved failure: excessive numeric precision
Candidate 001, Q05 static sheet, 1280×720 CSS viewport (reported DPR 2), exploration at cursor 0. The unrounded long radius label violates the declared six-decimal presentation. This original also shows unselected response options; it supplies no keyed answer. The image is a viewport capture, not a whole-page comparison. Bracketing observations 7–8.
The corrected supplied slice sheet
Candidate 002, Q05 static sheet, 1280×720 CSS viewport (DPR 1), exploration at cursor 0. The supplied balls and boundary point are distinct and numeric labels use six decimals. The queried unshown setting is not added to the sheet. Each ball drawing occupies 143×103 CSS pixels; the tables carry explicit numerical information. Bracketing observations 62–63.
Local objects retain the source records
Candidate 002, Q08 Local objects, frame F3, 960×720 CSS viewport (DPR 1), exploration at cursor 0. The two local references, revised receiving rule and full cost records are visible after scrolling. Card position adds no relation or receiver result. No response is selected or explanation revealed. Bracketing observations 98–99.
The plain view exposes the same facts
Candidate 002, Q08 Plain table, frame F3, 960×720 CSS viewport (DPR 1), exploration at cursor 0. The identical facts appear as rows, with unselected response controls below. This image is framed at a different scroll position from Local objects; the browser frame/information hashes establish parity, not the crop. Bracketing observations 104–105.

Static selected-point sheet · Active tour · Final pristine state

Evidence, revision and limits

The closed final core has 214 observations, 94 successful host action calls, 11 original JPEGs and 115 activity rows—106 UI events and 9 API transactions. All 21 closed files were rehashed. Nine checkpoints match across four passes: baseline, restored, reopened and reloaded. The full tour was observed active, at 22.2s and at its natural 48s end; final state is paused 0 with no answers or reveals.

One explicitly software-marked option submission and one null skip exercised the response/reveal paths. Neither is Paul’s answer or a participant outcome. The first elapsed observation of the short prescribed sequence was its 6s end; no intermediate short-sequence observation is claimed.

Candidate 001 retained 23 observations and 4 originals after event-schema, incomplete-inspector and numeric-display failures. Candidate 002 corrects those defects and passes the independent audit. All 15 Gate 7 originals remain preserved; one justified revision was used.

Public route checks deny 16 private/internal/traversal GET paths. The held answer key is not a public asset. Submit is ungraded; reveal requires its matching receipt. Full response logs and numerical oracles remain local audit material.

No horizontal page overflow was observed at 1280×720 or 960×720. Complete records and the inspector require vertical scrolling at 960px; six-ball thumbnails are small. The queried console had no warnings/errors. Manual paused controls were tested; OS reduced-motion emulation and cross-device pixel identity were not.

Astra: specification/synthesis. Sol: implementation and a separate independent audit. Luna: primary-source review. Host: actual browser operation and evidence. These are software-agent roles. No human study, deployment or four-agent language protocol occurred.

Machine-readable result · Evaluation source review

The final replay collection

All 872 previous frozen manifest entries remain unchanged. All seven historical servers passed read-only HTTP checks; Gate 3 and Gate 6 were also opened through actual browser links and their paused run/build identities inspected. Their original qualifications remain in their packets.

g6-0279cdcdc0adc9b0
Gate 7

G7-INTERPRET-002
g7-90e64952eb028069

Exact run/build collection and restart commands

Loopback previews on this Mac; no permanent hosting claim. This exact Gate 7 snapshot uses Node v24.17.0:

/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node@24/24.17.0/bin/node /Users/paul/BTC-Learning/experiments/looking-glass/interpretation/builds/g7-90e64952eb028069/server.mjs
The sequence ends here

Keep the instrument as a reproducible model-and-observation tool. The smallest proposed next experiment is one separately requested, recorded think-aloud session on unrevealed cases, with a fixed first-exposure plan and plain comparison. It would provide individual usability evidence, not population efficacy.

That session and all further scope remain unapproved and unrun. No new objects, formal bundle construction, VR or shared-meaning integration begins automatically.

A working instrument.
An open human question.

At 0s, compare Static sheet, Prescribed sequence and Choose a frame. The same finite observations and raw coordinate tables are available through different access patterns. Sequence frames last 2 seconds with no interpolation.
At 24s, inspect the supplied slice/projection sheet. At 42s, switch the same reference/receiver frame between Local objects and Plain table.
Submit an answer or skip, then intentionally choose Reveal model explanation. Submission alone gives no grading. Reopen saved start or reload clears the transient responses and explanations.
Replay from start visits all eight cases and naturally stops paused at 48s. It is a software demonstration with no participant answers.

Teaching: 60 seconds recommended; task time: 45 seconds recommended. These are proposed, unenforced limits, with pausing and revisiting available. No participant exposure or timing outcome was measured.

Five separate conclusions

The independent core audit passes the exact frozen build and closed evidence. Source-informed agents checked the model and interface; they did not take a human comprehension test.

The declared model and task instrument are internally consistent.	Recovery assumes supplied raw 3D coordinates, known transforms and correct point correspondence; it is not recovery from SVG pixels.
Information recovery and ambiguity	Distinguish properties determined by the supplied observations from compatible alternatives.	The audit verifies both determining observations and explicit non-uniqueness witnesses; exact task explanations remain behind deliberate reveal.	The instrument supports bounded model questions and preserves genuine insufficiency.	No arbitrary shape reconstruction, unique higher-dimensional physical cause, or general inference from appearance is established.

Human understanding is untested; there is no human score.	Accuracy, confusion, learning, transfer and perceived usefulness require actual participation.

The preserved Gate 4 example shows a stored 3D movie can reproduce a selected projection movie. Candidate 001 presentation/event defects are preserved and corrected in 002.	Faithful software and a convincing appearance do not by themselves establish unique origin or comprehension.	Propose one separately requested think-aloud session on unrevealed cases with a fixed first-exposure plan and plain comparison. It is unapproved and unrun.
